title: A finite closed family with geometrically irreducible generic traces stays so near the generic point
statement: Let $p:P\to T$ be a finite type morphism [def-weil-finite-type-morphism], let $\eta$ be a generic point of $T$, and let $I$ be a finite type indexing closed subsets $C_i\subseteq P$. Suppose for each $i$, every field $E$ and every $z:\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(\eta)$, the inverse image of $C_i$ under the geometric fibre inclusion $P_\eta\times_{\kappa(\eta)}\operatorname{Spec}E\to P$ is irreducible and nonempty [def-pc-scheme-fibre, def-pc-fibre-product, def-pc-geometrically-irreducible]. There is an open $U\subseteq T$ containing $\eta$ such that the corresponding inverse image of every $C_i$ is irreducible and nonempty for every $t\in U$, every field $E$ and every $z:\operatorname{Spec}E\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(t)$. No cover identity or intersection condition is assumed or concluded. Empty $I$ is allowed.

proof.text: Construct the reduced induced closed subscheme for each C_i as the subscheme of its vanishing ideal sheaf. Its inclusion j_i is a closed immersion with range C_i; its composite with p is finite type. Pullback pasting and the homeomorphism of an embedding onto its range identify geometric irreducibility of its fibre with the exact ambient inverse-image test in the statement. This comparison is proved in Lean by the private helpers closed_baseChange_irreducible_iff and closed_geometric_fibre_irreducible_iff.

Apply the one-scheme generic geometric irreducibility shrinking theorem to each composite j_i followed by p, using the proved comparison to supply its generic-fibre hypothesis. Obtain an open U_i containing eta on which all its fibres are geometrically irreducible.

Take the finite infimum of the U_i in T.Opens. Its underlying set is the finite intersection, hence contains eta. Each point in the infimum belongs to U_i for every index. Apply the same closed-subscheme comparison in the reverse direction to recover every asserted field-valued inverse-image test. If I is empty the infimum is top and the family condition is vacuous.

theorem exists_open_closed_family_geometric_fibre_shrink {P T : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : P ⟶ T) [LocallyOfFiniteType p] [QuasiCompact p]
    (η : T) (hη : IsGenericPoint η Set.univ) {I : Type u} [Finite I]
    (C : I → Set P) (hclosed : ∀ i, IsClosed (C i))
    (hgeom : ∀ i, ∀ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E)
      (z : Spec (CommRingCat.of E) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (T.residueField η))),
      IsIrreducible ((pullback.fst (p.fiberToSpecResidueField η) z ≫
        p.fiberι η) ⁻¹' C i)) :
    ∃ U : T.Opens, η ∈ U ∧ ∀ i t, t ∈ U →
      ∀ (E : Type u) (_ : Field E)
        (z : Spec (CommRingCat.of E) ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (T.residueField t))),
        IsIrreducible ((pullback.fst (p.fiberToSpecResidueField t) z ≫
          p.fiberι t) ⁻¹' C i)
